name: orbital-crash
description: Pure arcade survival — steer your star, annihilate opposite charge, survive the Anomalies.

scripts.build: rm -rf www && mkdir -p www && cp index.html bestiary.html manifest.webmanifest sw.js www/ && cp -R icons www/icons && mkdir -p www/art && cp art/*.webp www/art/ && mkdir -p www/audio && cp audio/*.mp3 www/audio/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.sync: npm run build && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 cap sync
scripts.ios: npm run sync && cap open ios
scripts.ios:fast: npm run build && cap copy ios && cap open ios
scripts.ios:live: LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 cap run ios --live-reload --host $(ipconfig getifaddr en0 || ipconfig getifaddr en1) --port 8778
scripts.icons:ios: rm -rf assets && mkdir -p assets && cp icons/icon-1024.png assets/icon.png && cp icons/icon-1024.png assets/logo.png && capacitor-assets generate --ios --splashBackgroundColor '#070b16' --splashBackgroundColorDark '#070b16' --logoSplashTargetWidth 1694 && python3 -c "from PIL import Image;import glob;[Image.open(f).save(f,optimize=True) for f in glob.glob('ios/App/App/Assets.xcassets/Splash.imageset/*.png')]"
scripts.serve: npm run build && cd www && python3 -m http.server 8777
